payload.title: Stories cannot show math: no equation support in Markus or the renderer
payload.description: A Machines on Machines Story on non-interference needs to state formal bounds, such as an attacker's chance being at most m / 2^k. A search of src, docs, web, components, package.json and pyproject.toml found no KaTeX, MathJax or MathML, apart from the bundled mermaid.min.js, and docs/markus*.md has no mention of math. Decide the markup, render it statically in the projection, and support both themes and the newsletter fallback.
